name: currency-exchange-field
title: Currency exchange field
description: You send, they get: two linked amounts in two currencies tied together by the rates you supply, so editing either side updates the other.
docs: value and onValueChange speak { send, receive, fixed }: each side is { minor, currency } in minor units (1250 is 12.50 in euros and 1,250 in yen) and fixed is the side typed last. rates is a table or a function (from, to) => rate. min, max and fee.flat are minor units of the currency sent, so pass one figure per currency code when several can be sent.
